mechanisms.decisive_claim: For every leaf j in the power-large simultaneous normal form, the five aggregate unit variables (g,f,b,r_j,q_j) and the five actual source, complement and identity rows have exactly the m=1 formal coefficient matrix.
mechanisms.kill_test: Extract rows directly from Fj=GRj, PA0=GB, B=RjQj and PAj=F0Qj and compare coefficient vectors.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The quotient identity b-r_j-q_j=0 adds an independent rank beyond the four actual product-observable rows.
mechanisms.kill_test: Compute its linear dependence on the four product rows.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Common X and paired positivity algebraically force every actual product-unit right side to equal the special scalar multiples used in the finite formal example, without conditioning.
mechanisms.kill_test: Retain arbitrary units of Fj,F0,PAj,PA0 and kill if the multiplicative identities constrain only their sum relation.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A nontrivial sign-torsion observable remains after normalizing all five aggregate factors by positive augmentation.
mechanisms.kill_test: Orient G,Rj,B,Qj,F0 by their positive nonzero augmentations and test the sign equations.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Tensoring the primitive scalar incidence matrix with the actual free abelian exponent lattice creates an additional observable kernel not generated coordinatewise by gauge.
mechanisms.kill_test: Put Gamma isomorphic to Z^r and compute the tensor kernel using the unit maximal minor.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every internal associate-unit redistribution among normalized irreducible occurrences of B changes at least one actual source or complement product mask.
mechanisms.kill_test: Write aggregate units as occurrence sums and test directions in the projection kernel.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The five-variable aggregate formal matrix is the complete raw factor-occurrence unit matrix whenever Omega(B)>1.
mechanisms.kill_test: Expand B into at least two occurrences and exhibit omitted occurrence-normalization coordinates or prove a canonical quotient.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: After choosing normalized associate representatives, the actual multiplicative identities introduce no aggregate unit variables beyond G,F0,B,R_j,Q_j for one centre-leaf block.
mechanisms.kill_test: Audit every factor in the four simultaneous identities and reject any unnamed aggregate factor.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The power-large simultaneous-switch theorem already proves that all absolute product-unit observable rows are constant on a t^(5/9-o(1)) subfamily at t^o(1) cost.
mechanisms.kill_test: Locate an explicit joint-profile count and retained-fibre inequality; absence of such a theorem is inconclusive unless a legal counterfamily is built.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Before fixing absolute complement observables, the actual aggregate source-identity subsystem has only the projective gauge kernel.
mechanisms.kill_test: Delete PAj and PA0 rows and compute the common spectrum-shift direction.

mechanisms.kill_test: Exhibit a unit maximal minor and solve the actual affine system over each exponent coordinate.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The local aggregate realization lemma alone retains the all-target occurrence mass and proves a dimension-three distance exponent strictly above 3/5.
